question: When rival AI companies agree on safety rules, who else should be part of that conversation?
reflection: When competitors share what they learn about risk, safety can become a common good instead of a trade secret.

sources.subject: Meta turns AI tools into a subscription
Salesforce+Claude CRM, Odyssey-3 Universal Robot Brain, LongCat Av

one_line: Business software is folding AI into everyday tools, while the leading labs reportedly start talking to each other about safety.

top_stories.title: Three leading labs reportedly coordinate on safety
top_stories.what: OpenAI's policy chief says the company has been talking with Anthropic and Google DeepMind for several weeks about shared safety measures.
top_stories.why: Shared safety norms will need evidence on how people actually use and misuse AI, which behavioural research can supply.

top_stories.title: Sales software moves inside the chat window
top_stories.what: Salesforce data can now be read and updated from inside Claude in an open beta, and Salesforce also launched its own business reasoning model, Koa, built with NVIDIA.
top_stories.why: When staff work through a chat assistant instead of screens, how they trust and check its answers becomes a design question worth studying.

top_stories.title: One model to steer robots, cars and drones
top_stories.what: Odyssey released Odyssey-3, a world model that reportedly controls many kinds of machines from one shared core and trains them in simulated worlds.
top_stories.why: Training machines in simulation lowers the cost of testing, which matters for countries planning robotics and smart transport.

saudi_lens.text: An energy major is funding custom AI models for oil and gas exploration with a European lab, a model that Saudi energy and research bodies could study for their own subsurface data.

idea.title: Trust in chat-based work tools
idea.pitch: Study how employees decide when to accept or double-check answers from an AI assistant connected to company records.
idea.first_step: Draft five realistic tasks and a short survey on confidence before and after checking the AI's answer.

idea_kids.title: Robot rules card game
idea_kids.pitch: Children play robot makers from rival teams who must agree on three safety rules before any robot can leave the factory.
idea_kids.first_step: Write twelve robot cards, each with one useful power and one possible risk.

watchlist.name: Odyssey
watchlist.note: Public access to its multi-machine model is promised within weeks.

watchlist.name: Mistral AI
watchlist.note: Building industry-specific models with large energy firms.

watchlist.name: Meta
watchlist.note: Testing whether people will pay monthly for AI image and video tools.

tool.name: LongCat-Video-Avatar
tool.use: Open-source model that turns a photo and an audio clip into a talking video; needs a large GPU.

verify: OpenAI says it does not need an antitrust waiver to coordinate on safety with rivals.
Meta's Instagram subscription revenue reportedly rose 475% in one week.

entities.name: Meta
entities.note: Launched a paid AI tools bundle across its apps.

terms.definition: An AI model that learns how a physical or simulated world behaves, so it can predict what happens next and plan actions.
Training a robot or vehicle in a computer simulation and then using what it learned in the real world.
A model whose trained parameters are published so others can run and adapt it themselves.

concepts.summary: Competing AI labs talk directly about shared safety measures.
Business systems are used through a chat assistant instead of their own screens.
One shared model is adapted to control many kinds of machines.
